caption: At a hallway snack table, the person in the dark navy hoodie leans in beside a person in gray, reaches into the rows of plastic water bottles and handles one at the bottle tops; a single bottle is then held low at their side, though which of the two people holds it is unclear because their arms overlap.

labels.action: reaches both hands toward the rows of water bottles on the table
handles bottles at their caps and appears to take one plastic water bottle
a plastic water bottle hangs low at the side, held by a hand that cannot be attributed to one person
hands are held close together in front of the chest; whether they hold anything cannot be seen

scene.setting: hallway snack table with water bottles and chip bags next to lockers

issues: Two people stand close with overlapping arms, so it is unclear whose hand takes and holds the bottle, and the hands at the end are partly hidden.
